repomix.user_provided_header: Inventory frontend/backend integration handoff. Scope: branches/warehouses, locations, stock balances, adjustments, movement ledger, transfers, stocktakes and production receipts only. Preserve Vortix RTL design and existing auth. Read bags-platform/docs/inventory-frontend-integration-handoff.md first. Includes current mock UI and original exuction.txt, API client, Laravel contracts/services/models/schema, permissions and tests. Shared files may mention unrelated modules; POS/cashier implementation is outside scope. No environment secrets are included.
